title: Invoice response
description: What POST /offers/{offer_id}/invoice returns: 201 for a new invoice, 200 with idempotent_replay for a repeated request (docs/spec-v1.md, section 7.2). A resolver may add members. None of this is to be trusted: the payer reads the invoice with its own node and checks it against the signed offer (spec 9).

invoice.description: The Fiber invoice string, from the merchant node.

idempotent_replay.description: Present and true when this is the response to an earlier request with the same key.
